verdicts.label: product-bug
verdicts.rootCause: Escrow accounting arithmetic underflows at small quoteScale values due to precision loss in fixed-point math during order settlement.

verdicts.label: product-bug
verdicts.rootCause: Arithmetic overflow in notional calculation when processing limit orders with maximum uint128 values, causing panic instead of proper InsufficientBalance error.

verdicts.label: test-equipment
verdicts.rootCause: Test generator is not producing the intended volume of test data; only 300 of 360 configured sessions were generated, indicating a configuration or implementation issue in the array generation harness.

verdicts.label: test-equipment
verdicts.rootCause: Invariant handler silently catches and discards revert exceptions that should have failed the invariants, preventing detection of the limit-price violation.

verdicts.label: test-bug
verdicts.rootCause: Replay reconstruction logic fails to include the price field when rebuilding the order book state from historical events.

verdicts.label: test-bug
verdicts.rootCause: Test assertion inverted: negation operator applied to equality check that should be positive, causing correct behavior to fail.

verdicts.label: environment
verdicts.rootCause: Test hook timeout threshold (60000ms) is marginally lower than typical setup execution time (60422ms), causing flaky failures under resource contention.

verdicts.label: test-equipment
verdicts.rootCause: FOK fillability scan logic is not exercised by the test suite, allowing a break→continue mutation to survive without observable behavioral change in tested scenarios.

verdicts.label: test-equipment
verdicts.rootCause: The invariant harness does not exercise the order placement codepath, so the invariant cannot detect actual contract behavior and fails immediately as a coverage check rather than a real invariant.

verdicts.label: test-equipment
verdicts.rootCause: Ledger conservation test does not exercise counterparty isolation and accepts mutations that collapse buyer/seller identity.

verdicts.label: environment
verdicts.rootCause: Port 8080 is not properly released between test runs when parallel worker count exceeds 4, causing intermittent EADDRINUSE errors on retry.

verdicts.label: product-bug
verdicts.rootCause: Order cancellation leaves zero-quantity price level entries in the book instead of removing the level entirely.
